# PiliNara settings source snapshot

This directory is an unmodified source snapshot of
`lib/pages/setting/` from [Starfallan/PiliNara](https://github.com/Starfallan/PiliNara)
commit `b908eccfbcc3930c5ead47bc728e164ff1675cf6`, imported on 2026-10-18.

It is licensed under GPL-3.0-or-later; its original `LICENSE` is included.
The snapshot is intentionally outside Lumtub's `lib/` directory, so the
PiliNara application dependencies do not become build dependencies. Lumtub
will adapt and retain suitable pieces incrementally in `lib/widgets/`.
